review_title: Tricyclic drugs for depression in children and adolescents
screening_criteria: Randomised controlled trials comparing the efficacy of orally administered tricyclic drugs with placebo in depressed people aged 6 to 18 years.
gold_label_policy_description: dataset label 1.0 counts as INCLUDE; 0.5 and 0.0 count as EXCLUDE

studies.study_title: Pulse intravenous clomipramine for depressed adolescents: double‐blind, controlled trial
studies.predicted_reason: Non-oral route (intravenous clomipramine) despite RCT in depressed adolescents; review includes only orally administered TCAs vs placebo.

studies.study_title: A double‐blind, randomized, placebo‐controlled trial of fluoxetine in children and adolescents with depression
studies.predicted_reason: Fluoxetine is an SSRI, not a tricyclic; outside intervention scope.

studies.study_title: Double‐blind placebo‐controlled study of nortriptyline in depressed adolescents using a "fixed plasma level" design
studies.predicted_reason: Double-blind, placebo-controlled RCT of oral nortriptyline in 12–17-year-olds with major depression; matches population, design, and intervention.

studies.study_title: Childhood and adolescent depression: a review of the past 10 years. Part I
studies.predicted_reason: Narrative review; not a randomized controlled trial.

studies.study_title: Imipramine treatment of depressed children: a double‐blind pilot study
studies.predicted_reason: Double-blind pilot RCT of oral imipramine vs placebo in depressed children; within age range and design criteria.

studies.study_title: Amitriptyline in children with major depressive disorder: a double‐blind crossover pilot study
studies.predicted_reason: Double-blind crossover RCT of oral amitriptyline vs placebo in 9–12-year-olds with MDD; meets all criteria.

studies.study_title: Newer generation antidepressants for depressive disorders in children and adolescents
studies.predicted_reason: Focus on newer-generation antidepressants (e.g., SSRIs), not tricyclics; not within intervention scope.

studies.study_title: Imipramine plus cognitive‐behavioural therapy in the treatment of school refusal
studies.predicted_reason: Double-blind RCT of oral imipramine vs placebo (both with CBT) in adolescents with comorbid anxiety and major depression; includes depressed participants and placebo comparator.

studies.study_title: Imipramine in prepubertal major depressive disorders
studies.predicted_reason: Double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of oral imipramine in prepubertal children with MDD; eligible population and design.

studies.study_title: Efficacy of paroxetine treatment in the treatment of adolescent depression: a randomized, controlled trial
studies.predicted_reason: Adolescent MDD RCT includes imipramine vs placebo arm alongside paroxetine; provides tricyclic vs placebo comparison.

studies.study_title: Mechanism of action of antidepressant medications
studies.predicted_reason: Mechanistic review; not a randomized controlled trial in the target population.

studies.study_title: SSRI safety in overdose
studies.predicted_reason: Overdose/safety review of SSRIs; not TCA efficacy and not an RCT.

studies.study_title: Measuring inconsistency in meta‐analyses
studies.predicted_reason: Methodological paper; not a pediatric RCT of tricyclics.

studies.study_title: Clinical, electrocardiographic, and laboratory findings in children with amitriptyline intoxication
studies.predicted_reason: Observational intoxication/poisoning series; not a depression treatment RCT.

studies.study_title: The effect of concomitant disorders in childhood depression on predicting treatment response
studies.predicted_reason: Predictor/response analysis without clear RCT design of oral TCA vs placebo; insufficient trial details at abstract stage.

studies.study_title: Adolescent depression: controlled desipramine treatment and atypical features
studies.predicted_reason: Randomized desipramine vs placebo in adolescents with MDD after placebo run-in; oral TCA and eligible design.

studies.study_title: Psychopharmacology of child and adolescent major depression: present status and future directions
studies.predicted_reason: Review/perspective; not a randomized controlled trial.

studies.study_title: Comparative studies of pharmacotherapy for school refusal
studies.predicted_reason: Includes a double-blind study in school refusal, but population not clearly depressed (primary anxiety/school refusal); does not meet depression-specific inclusion.

studies.study_title: Selected tricyclic antidepressant ingestions involving children 6 years old or less
studies.predicted_reason: Poison control ingestions; not an RCT and not a depression treatment population.

studies.study_title: A randomized, controlled trial of amitriptyline in the acute treatment of adolescent major depression
studies.predicted_reason: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of oral amitriptyline in adolescents with MDD; meets all criteria.

studies.study_title: School phobia: a therapeutic trial with clomipramine and short‐term outcome
studies.predicted_reason: Trial in school phobia/neurotic disorder; depressed population not clearly defined as MDD; outside target population.

studies.study_title: Meta‐analysis of early phase II studies with paroxetine in hospitalised depressed patients
studies.predicted_reason: Adult inpatient sample (18–65 years) and paroxetine vs amitriptyline; outside pediatric age range.

studies.study_title: Depression in children: relationship between plasma imipramine levels and response
studies.predicted_reason: Open-label plasma level–response study without randomized placebo control; not an RCT.

studies.study_title: Randomized, controlled trial of amitriptyline versus placebo for adolescents with "treatment‐resistant" major depression
studies.predicted_reason: Randomized, placebo-controlled trial of oral amitriptyline in adolescents with treatment-resistant MDD; eligible design and population.

studies.study_title: Imipramine compliance in adolescents
studies.predicted_reason: Nested within an 8-week double-blind RCT of oral imipramine vs placebo (with CBT) in anxious-depressed adolescents; trial data relevant to TCA vs placebo; include conservatively.
